title: Tailwise Plus Annual First-Term Fee — Membership Billing Calculation Sheet
content:
**Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus — first-term fee of Tailwise Plus Annual bought from a free tier.**

**Fee.** The first-term Plus Annual fee is $59.00, the membership fee of Tailwise Plus Annual, charged to the card on file on the purchase date; the paid term starts that day.

**Free trial.** A customer with no membership fee charged in the 365 calendar days before the purchase is in a free trial and is charged nothing on the purchase date.

**Order of working.** Amounts applied to the $59.00 fee are applied in a fixed order: a credit drawn from membership fees already charged comes off the $59.00 fee first, the fee left after it never going below zero; a percentage rate then applies once to that reduced fee; flat dollar credits are then subtracted from the result. No step acts on the original fee again.

**Floor and rounding.** The first-term Plus Annual fee is never below zero and is rounded to the nearest cent as the last step.

### Trial look-back — both sides (hypothetical purchase on 10 September 2026)

| Latest membership fee charged | Days before the purchase | Free trial | Charged on the purchase date |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10 September 2025 | 365 | no | the first-term fee |
| 9 September 2025 | 366 | yes | $0.00 |
| never | — | yes | $0.00 |

### Worked fee (hypothetical, no trial, nothing applied to the fee)
$59.00, rounded to the cent: $59.00 charged on the purchase date.

### Rounding at the end (hypothetical intermediate figures)
A fee worked through to $41.2875 is charged as $41.29; one worked through to a figure below zero is charged as $0.00.
